system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Swirling Seals

Lacking the knowledge or access to the Fuinjutsu of the Uzumaki clan, you choose to instead focus on perfecting and mastering an established technique to make it more of your own.

Select one jutsu you know that is not your Original Technique. If you do not have the Original Technique mutation, you must select a Hijutsu you know instead. This jutsu, becomes known as your Fundamental Technique. Each time you cast your Fundamental Technique; you may select one of the following benefits it will gain as part of its casting. You can select one additional Jutsu at 7th and 15th levels.

Fundamental Stability. If the jutsu requires concentration, it gains the Stable keyword.

Fundamental Efficiency. If the jutsu requires concentration, it gains the Efficient keyword.

Fundamental Ability. This jutsu gains the Hijutsu keyword.
